highlights.title: Anthropic’s $1.4 Trillion IPO Bet Tests AI Appetite
highlights.description: Bloomberg’s Riley Griffin breaks down Anthropic's big goal of seeking a $1.4 trillion valuation in an IPO that could raise more money than SpaceX's blockbuster debut. Plus, Nvidia shares are down for a second straight day following the scandal surrounding CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy; and SoftBank reports a $7 billion net loss in the second quarter, its first loss in nearly two years. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Can DeepSeek challenge OpenAI, Anthropic in AI agents as Harness adoption takes off?
highlights.description: DeepSeek’s Harness artificial intelligence agent framework has reached 1.54 million daily active users less than three months after launch, the Chinese AI champion said on Sunday, marking rapid growth in a new battleground between leading Chinese and American AI giants. Users of Harness through the company’s official application programming interface were consuming around 92 trillion tokens a day as of November 4, the Hangzhou-based start-up said. That is equivalent to about 1.1 billion tokens..
